findings.impact: A previously accepted/reviewed driver may be substituted by a newly authorized unreviewed driver without invalidating the old acceptance. This is internal review/admission continuity, not an authentication/cryptographic human-authority claim.
findings.minimumFix: Require scoped acceptance to bind the exact current driver plan and reviewed packet identity; validate before daemon. Preserve historical assertions and require a new acceptance for changed driver.
findings.observed: authorize accepted even when acceptance and old review explicitly contain a different plan/packet identity. Driver-review artifact content is never bound to current driver plan/packet.
findings.trigger: Fresh current-plan authorization plus a previously scoped acceptance and hash-valid old driverReviewFreeze, all source/image/environment/projection unchanged.

findings.disposition: requires exact tmpfs inspect policy amendment
findings.impact: The actual inspect admission does not enforce its intended resource/security/mount policy. Exact generated create argv remains safe and no unsafe actual execution is asserted.
findings.minimumFix: Keep historical helper immutable; successor collection inspect wrapper should enforce the exact intended tmpfs roots/options, rejecting duplicates/conflicts/extra roots and unknowns, with representation-matching positives.
findings.observed: All three actual-state mutations accepted because frozen helper checks required option membership but not conflicting/duplicate options or exact tmpfs keys.
findings.trigger: Mutate actual inspect HostConfig.Tmpfs to append size=16g after size=8g, append suid after nosuid, or add an extra /workspace/extra overlay.

findings.disposition: requires bounded package parser consistency amendment
findings.impact: Parser accepts malformed/contradictory Go metadata as inventory. No claim these are normal native Go output; targeted fake counterexamples exercise fail-closed evidence admission.
findings.minimumFix: Bind package directory to module-relative ImportPath; require safe unique basename .go file identities, and where feasible bind selected paths to validated source inventory. Preserve legitimate Cgo/Test/XTest and zero-test package cases.
findings.observed: All three contradictory package inventories accepted. Directory only needs to be somewhere under CWD; selected files only need be nonempty strings lacking slash.
findings.trigger: Required package ImportPath with a different in-checkout directory; GoFiles=[".."]; duplicate selected source filename.
